dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Good morning! May I see your passport and booking confirmation?
dialogue.text_uz: Xayrli tong! Pasport va band qilish tasdig'ingizni ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.answer: Of course, here they are. I'd also like a window seat, please.
dialogue.answer_uz: Albatta, mana. Deraza yoniga o'tirmoqchiman, iltimos.
options: Of course, here they are. I'd also like a window seat, please.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.answer: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. You'll see it on your right.
dialogue.answer_uz: To'g'ri ikki kvartalgacha boring, keyin chapga buriling. O'ng tomonda ko'rasiz.
options: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. You'll see it on your right.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Do you have any rooms available for tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.answer: Yes, we have a double room. Would you like breakfast included?
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, ikki kishilik xonamiz bor. Nonushta kiritilsinmi?
options: Yes, we have a double room. Would you like breakfast included?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: What is the purpose of your visit?

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.answer: I'm here on vacation for two weeks.
options: I'm here on vacation for two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Can you take me to the Hilton Hotel, please?
dialogue.text_uz: Meni Hilton mehmonxonasiga olib bora olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.answer: Sure! It'll take about 20 minutes. Please fasten your seatbelt.
dialogue.answer_uz: Albatta! Taxminan 20 daqiqa davom etadi. Kamar taqing, iltimos.
options: Sure! It'll take about 20 minutes. Please fasten your seatbelt.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: My luggage didn't arrive. Can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.answer: I'm sorry to hear that. Please fill out this form with a description of your bag.
dialogue.answer_uz: Bundan xafa bo'ldim. Sumkangiz tavsifini bu formaga to'ldiring, iltimos.
options: I'm sorry to hear that. Please fill out this form with a description of your bag.
I don't know where it is.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: I'd like to exchange US dollars for euros, please.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.answer: Certainly. Today's rate is 0.92 euros per dollar. How much would you like to exchange?
dialogue.answer_uz: Albatta. Bugungi kurs bir dollar uchun 0.92 evro. Qancha ayirboshlamoqchisiz?
options: Certainly. Today's rate is 0.92 euros per dollar. How much would you like to exchange?

context_uz: Mahalliy diqqatga sazovor joylar haqida so'rash

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: What are the must-see places in this city?
dialogue.text_uz: Bu shahardagi albatta ko'rish kerak bo'lgan joylar qaysilar?

dialogue.speaker: Concierge
dialogue.answer: I'd recommend the old town, the national museum, and the riverside park.
dialogue.answer_uz: Eski shahar, milliy muzey va daryo bo'yidagi bog'ni tavsiya qilaman.
options: I'd recommend the old town, the national museum, and the riverside park.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: My flight has been delayed. What are my options?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.answer: We can rebook you on the next flight or provide a voucher for meals and accommodation.
dialogue.answer_uz: Sizni keyingi parvozga o'tkazishimiz yoki ovqat va turar joy uchun kupon berishimiz mumkin.
options: We can rebook you on the next flight or provide a voucher for meals and accommodation.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: What's the best way to get around the city?
dialogue.text_uz: Shahar bo'ylab yurish uchun eng yaxshi yo'l qanday?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.answer: The metro is the fastest and cheapest option. You can buy a day pass at any station.
dialogue.answer_uz: Metro eng tez va arzon variant. Kunlik yo'l chiptasini har qanday stantsiyadan sotib olishingiz mumkin.
options: The metro is the fastest and cheapest option. You can buy a day pass at any station.
